Interface HoldDailyTotalStateJpaRepository

All Superinterfaces:
org.springframework.data.repository.CrudRepository<HoldDailyTotalState, Integer>, org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.JpaRepository<HoldDailyTotalState, Integer>, org.springframework.data.repository.ListCrudRepository<HoldDailyTotalState, Integer>, org.springframework.data.repository.ListPagingAndSortingRepository<HoldDailyTotalState, Integer>, org.springframework.data.repository.PagingAndSortingRepository<HoldDailyTotalState, Integer>, org.springframework.data.repository.query.QueryByExampleExecutor<HoldDailyTotalState>, org.springframework.data.repository.Repository<HoldDailyTotalState, Integer>
public interface HoldDailyTotalStateJpaRepository extends org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.JpaRepository<HoldDailyTotalState, Integer>
Per tenant marker of hold_daily_total. Internal state of the task HOLD_DAILY_TOTAL_UPDATE; no REST repository is exposed. None of the modifying methods opens a transaction of its own: each runs in the transaction of its caller, so that a booking and the lowering of the marker commit or roll back together.

  • Method Details

    • lockByIdTenant

      @Lock(PESSIMISTIC_WRITE) @Query("SELECT s FROM HoldDailyTotalState s WHERE s.idTenant = ?1") Optional<HoldDailyTotalState> lockByIdTenant(Integer idTenant)
      Reads the marker of a tenant and locks it until the end of the transaction. The update task holds this lock while it recomputes the tenant, so a booking that lowers the marker meanwhile waits and lowers the marker the task has just written, instead of being overwritten by it.
      Parameters:
      idTenant - the tenant
      Returns:
      the locked marker, empty when the tenant has never been computed

    • lowerRecalcFromDate

      @Modifying @Query(value="UPDATE hold_daily_total_state SET recalc_from_date = LEAST(recalc_from_date, ?2) WHERE id_tenant = ?1", nativeQuery=true) int lowerRecalcFromDate(Integer idTenant, LocalDate fromDate)
      Lowers the marker of a tenant to the given day, unless it already lies on or before it. A tenant without a marker is left alone, it is computed in full anyway.
      Parameters:
      idTenant - the tenant
      fromDate - the first day whose rows a change has made outdated
      Returns:
      1 when the tenant has a marker, 0 when it has never been computed

    • removeByIdTenant

      @Modifying @Query(value="DELETE FROM hold_daily_total_state WHERE id_tenant = ?1", nativeQuery=true) int removeByIdTenant(Integer idTenant)
      Removes the marker of a tenant, so that the next run computes its whole history again.
      Parameters:
      idTenant - the tenant
      Returns:
      the number of removed rows, 0 or 1

    • removeAllStates

      @Modifying @Query(value="DELETE FROM hold_daily_total_state", nativeQuery=true) int removeAllStates()
      Removes the marker of every tenant, so that the next run computes all of them in full.

    • getDatabaseNow

      @Query(value="SELECT NOW()", nativeQuery=true) LocalDateTime getDatabaseNow()
      The current time of the database. historyquote.create_modify_time is set by the database, so the time a quote scan starts is taken from the same clock.
      Returns:
      the database time, in UTC because the sessions are pinned to UTC
